symptom: A family of sweep runs writes a result file to disk on every run. The files are well-formed, current, and correct. Nothing anywhere reads them: the quantities they hold are computed, serialised, and never enter any later calculation, report, or decision.
mechanism_as_described: The sweeps vary the system's own tuning constants one at a time and record how much its outputs move in response. Producing that record is the entire point of the runs, and the producing side is complete — the runs execute, the files are written, the numbers in them are right. What was never built is the reading side. No report, no check and no later stage opens the files, so the measurement is taken and then discarded. Nothing fails, because nothing depended on the values, and the only outward sign is that the files exist while no code names them.
detection_path: Listing every result file on disk and searching the whole source tree for any reference to each filename. A file that one script writes and no other script mentions anywhere is unread by construction, and that is checkable without knowing anything about what the file contains.
consequence: The system measures how tightly its own results depend on its tuning constants and then throws the answer away. No wrong value is emitted and no output is corrupted; what is lost is that a question was answered and the answer never reached anyone. The published account states the loss in exactly that form and records no repair for this instance.

symptom: Generated records carry their own individual identifier and no group identifier. The grouping that says which records belong together does exist — it was computed and written to a manifest beside them, and it is also recoverable from the file-naming convention — but it is not present as a fact inside the records, which is the only place the query machinery looks.
mechanism_as_described: The generation step computes the grouping and writes it out as a manifest alongside the records it describes. Writing the manifest completed the producing side, so the step read as finished. The separate act of stamping each record with its group identifier was never done. About eighty-three records were emitted carrying an individual identifier and no group identifier. Every later query that needs to gather all the records of one group asks the records, not the manifest — so the grouping is unavailable to it. The information exists in two places, and neither of them is the place that gets consulted.
detection_path: Scanning the generated records for those that carry the individual identifier and lack the group identifier, and counting them. It is a two-term test on each file and requires no understanding of what the grouping means or of what the manifest says.
consequence: The machinery that operates across all the records of one group could not gather a group's members at all. The grouping was correct and current throughout; it simply was not a fact that anything could ask for.

symptom: Four separate documents were all in use as the place where outstanding work was recorded. Each was maintained, each read as a legitimate list, and none of them stated that it was the list. The routine that updated them at the end of a working session named only some of the four.
mechanism_as_described: The four documents accumulated over time, each added when a need for it arose and none of them retiring the others. Nothing recorded which one was the one to consult, so that fact lived only with whoever happened to be writing. Because the end-of-session routine named a subset, the documents it named stayed current and the ones it did not name drifted, with no moment at which anything failed — each document on its own remained internally coherent and perfectly readable, and a drifted one is indistinguishable from a current one by inspection. One of the unnamed documents held a live outstanding work item that the routine never reconciled, and it sat there unreconciled.
detection_path: Comparing the set of documents actually serving as recording surfaces against the set the update routine names, rather than reading any one of them. Reading a drifted document does not reveal the drift, because there is nothing inside it to reveal; the discrepancy is only visible between the inventory and the routine.
consequence: Work recorded in an unnamed document could sit indefinitely without being carried forward, while the act of recording it read as having been done. The resolution taken was to consolidate onto a single recording surface and delete the rest.

symptom: A closing summary reported three changes as made and checked. Attached to it was the confirming output for one of them — the last. The other two were reported in the same sentence, in the same form, with the same finality, and carried nothing.
mechanism_as_described: The report of the work and the evidence for the work are two different things, and only the second is checkable by anyone else. Because the summary stated all three changes in one grammatical breath, the confirming output belonging to the third was carried backwards over the first two by the reader's eye. Nothing marks the difference at the point of reading: a change that was made and shown and a change that was merely asserted occupy the same sentence and look the same. The published account states the shape as a count mismatch — a report of some number of changes accompanied by fewer than that many pieces of confirming output — and names three-reported-one-shown as the case it observed.
detection_path: Counting the pieces of confirming output attached to a report and comparing that count against the number of changes the report claims. The comparison is arithmetic and does not require judging whether any individual change was correct, or even understanding what the changes were.
consequence: Two changes entered the record as done and checked on the strength of a third change's evidence. The stated remedy is that a completion claim arriving without its own attached output be read as unverified regardless of how the summary reads, and that a claim whose evidence cannot be produced at the time be recorded as still open instead.

symptom: A comparison routine reported that a quantity was unrecorded for a set of records and, on that basis, treated them as having nothing to compare. The quantity was in fact recorded for those records — as a series of values at real dates — and the routine had asked for it at one fixed index that none of those series contains.
mechanism_as_described: The comparison asked each record for the quantity at a single synthetic index chosen as a common baseline. Fifteen records carry the quantity only as a dated series, at points such as 1900, 1450 and 480 BC, and none of them holds an entry at the chosen index. The lookup therefore fell through to its no-data branch, and the caller read the result as 'not recorded'. Both available corrections went wrong, in opposite directions. The fall-through branch had been supplying an invented middle value, which fed a real-looking number into the comparison. Replacing that with a refusal removed the invented number, but it also discarded the recorded series along with it, and the comparison then reported full agreement between two readings that genuinely disagree — a robustness count moved from 0 to 156 and a real divergence between two categories was erased. Neither branch was the defect. The defect was that the question had been asked at an index the data was never recorded on.
detection_path: For every record the routine called unrecorded, enumerating the source entries at any index rather than only at the queried one. If entries exist elsewhere, the emptiness belongs to the query and not to the data, and that is directly countable without reasoning about the routine at all.
consequence: A genuine disagreement between two readings was reported as robust agreement across the board — the more damaging of the two outcomes, and the one produced by the repair rather than by the original defect. The stated correction is to establish, before treating an emptiness as real, whether a query on the data's own index would find the value; if it would, the query is what gets fixed.

symptom: A component's load output was routed through a filter that dropped every line containing the word warning. One such line — a reference to a module that no longer existed — was printed on every single load for four months and was seen by nobody. It ended when the dead reference was reached at run time and brought down the test suite.
mechanism_as_described: The filter was installed deliberately, because the channel was noisy and the noise was not interesting. It removes lines by one fixed rule applied to every line, and it cannot tell a routine noisy line from a line reporting a genuinely broken reference — both contain the word. So a channel that was quiet because there was nothing to report and a channel that was quiet because everything it reported was being discarded produced the same output: nothing. Each part was individually sound. The load really did emit the line; the filter really did what it was written to do; the reader really did see a clean channel. The loss happens where the three meet, which is why no check at any one of them would have caught it.
detection_path: Reading the channel unfiltered, or replacing the blanket removal with a list of the specific lines that are permitted to be dropped, so that anything not on the list survives to the reader. Under that arrangement the dead-reference line has nowhere to go and appears on the first load.
consequence: A broken reference stayed live and invisible for four months and then failed at run time, in the suite, at the point where it was most expensive. The stated remedy is that a channel must carry an explicit list of what its silence is allowed to mean, rather than a blanket rule for what to throw away.

symptom: An aggregate computed over a grid that was a quarter populated — eight cells of thirty-two, every one of them on a single level — was reported as a reading for the whole system, with a confident directional verdict beside it. A completeness figure of 0.25 was printed alongside, and nothing consulted it.
mechanism_as_described: The aggregate is assembled by collecting every value the grid can supply and combining what comes back. A level holding no values supplies nothing — it contributes silence rather than a mark saying it was not measured — so the collection simply returns a shorter list and the combination proceeds over it normally. The result is well formed and numerically unobjectionable; what it does not carry is how much of the grid it stands for. A reading taken over one level and a reading taken over four arrive at the consumer in the same shape, and the consumer that renders it as a system-wide verdict never asks which it is holding. The directional verdict was issued on the strength of a single level.
detection_path: Comparing the number of cells that actually fed the aggregate against the number the grid holds when full, and making the aggregate carry that ratio to wherever it is read. Here the ratio had already been computed and printed; what was missing was any consumer that required it, so the check is to have the consumer state what it needs and refuse when the ratio does not meet it.
consequence: A one-level measurement was published as a whole-system finding, carrying a directional verdict that a single level cannot support. The stated remedy is that adequacy is a property of the question being asked rather than of the data — one level is fine for a one-level question and worthless for a verdict that needs two — so the requirement has to be named by the consumer and cannot be set as one global threshold.
